narrative.overview: NetworkPilot behaves like a thoughtful exchange between Dylan and a capable networking assistant. A quiet shell surrounds one dominant work surface; the active person, message, and decision stay central while provider and diagnostic mechanics recede.
keyCharacteristics: One quiet sidebar and one dominant content surface.
People and writing carry more visual weight than system state.
The next-move region keeps state, explanation, and action in one stable place.
Desktop and mobile recompose structurally instead of shrinking the same layout.

rules.name: The One Next Move Rule
rules.body: Every active context ends with one plain-language state and one obvious next action.

rules.name: The Existing Pool Rule
rules.body: Add drafts always says it uses the existing pool and makes no provider call.

rules.name: The Provider Boundary Rule
rules.body: Find more is visually separate and explicitly says it may use Apollo.

rules.name: The Persistent Result Rule
rules.body: Add Drafts success, partial, and zero outcomes remain visible with the best recovery action.

dos: Do keep the person, message, and next action visible in the same working context.
Do keep blocked actions in place with a reason and recovery control.
Do use local state for selection and bucket switching when the required data is already loaded.
Do keep external consequences explicit and separately confirmed.
donts: Don't expose healthy provider, accounting, or evidence machinery in daily work.
Don't use permanent third columns, expanded bucket trees, or dashboard card walls.
Don't make zero-result actions look like no-ops.
Don't copy ChatGPT assets, exact layout, or brand treatment.
